verdict.rationale: Bento documents event-triggered workflows (trigger plus steps with delays), sequences with delays between emails, and one-time scheduled broadcast sends. None of these is a recurring time-based schedule for jobs or workflows. The homepage line about scripting 'the job you run every week' describes a user scripting the CLI and running it on their own, not a scheduler that Bento provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
